data: You perform a mystical dance, pumping yourself up. For the duration, double your proficiency bonus when making an attack.
Gets the Pokémon pumped up. Helps prevent nervousness, too.
Doubles the Appeal Points of a successful move in the next round. Pokemon also has advantage on CHA Saving Throws until after their move next round is performed.

You perform a mystical dance, pumping yourself up. For the duration, your Speed is increased by 10 feet and when you hit with a melee attack, you can deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line towards a target immediately before attacking it with a melee move, you have Advantage on the attack roll.
Also increases speed and confers advantage when attacking while moving.
